prompt: Which revision to the review meeting list best applies the memo to both teams’ submitted work?
promptZh: 針對兩隊實際提交的作品，哪項會議名單修正最符合備忘錄？

options.text: Reassign both entries: the final use of counters shows that Oriel kept Nessa’s trial contribution, just as Larch did.
options.zh: 兩案都改派其他審查者：和Larch一樣，Oriel的成品用到了小標記，顯示它保留奈莎在試作中的貢獻。
options.whyZh: Oriel確實也使用標記，但標記放在尚未完成的工作旁，並未沿時間刻度顯示等待多久。共用物件不等於沿用了奈莎的做法。

options.text: Reassign Larch’s full entry and leave Oriel’s entry with Nessa; Oriel’s submitted counters do a different job.
options.zh: Larch整案改派，Oriel仍由奈莎審查；Oriel提交的標記用途不同。
options.whyZh: Larch的成品仍把已完成的工作翻到邊條下遮住，保留奈莎的做法。Oriel則保留所有卡片可見，只用標記指出未完成的工作，不是沿時間刻度顯示等待多久，所以只改派Larch整案。

options.text: Reassign both entries: even if Oriel discarded the time-strip idea, the earlier mock-up gives Nessa the same conflict on both.
options.zh: 兩案都改派其他審查者：即使Oriel捨棄時間刻度的構想，奈莎曾參與試作，兩案仍有同樣的利益衝突。
options.whyZh: 審查規則看的是實際提交的提案或作品有沒有採用審查者的實質貢獻，而不是曾否使用某項試作。Larch沿用，Oriel的提交件未顯示沿用。

options.text: Assign another reviewer to score Larch’s sample, but keep Nessa on Larch’s proposal and on all of Oriel’s entry.
options.zh: 另請一位審查者評分Larch的樣本，但Larch的提案與Oriel整案仍由奈莎審查。
options.whyZh: Oriel可以由奈莎審查；Larch提交的樣本用了她的做法，迴避適用於整案，不能只把樣本改派而保留她評分提案。

explanationZh: Larch的成品仍把已完成的工作翻到邊條下遮住，保留奈莎的做法。Oriel則保留所有卡片可見，只用標記指出未完成的工作，不是沿時間刻度顯示等待多久，所以只改派Larch整案。
evidence: if the proposal or work sample actually submitted uses a substantive contribution that the reviewer made. / Compare the work, not its heading or wording. / reassign the affected entry without withdrawing it. / At a Larch practice session I built a working sample with one folding task tab. / its tab could tuck under a strip out of sight. / a counter that moves along a printed time strip so the supervisor can see how long a job has been waiting. / turning each finished card under the board's lip so only unfinished tasks can be seen. / all cards left visible and small counters moved beside the ones still to do.

vocabulary.note: 此處讓計數物沿著時間刻度移動，用來反映一項工作已等了多久。
指把原本由某人負責的工作改交他人處理；此處是改派審查員，不是撤件。
